'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Julian Smolarek LS Old Allies''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Julian Smolarek]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Julian Smolarek]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
